faqs.q: How quickly can a technician reach me?
faqs.a: For most services in our covered areas we offer same-day visits if you book before 2pm. Emergencies such as leaks or electrical faults are prioritised.

faqs.q: How do I know the price before the work starts?
faqs.a: We give you a quote in PKR before we begin. If our technician finds extra work on site, we explain it and get your approval first. No surprise charges.
Yes. Every job carries a 30-day service warranty. Some services, such as roof waterproofing and solar, carry longer warranties that are listed on their pages.
Yes. Everyone is ID-checked, trained and wears a uniform and a company card. You can ask to see it at the door.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Cash, bank transfer, JazzCash and Easypaisa. You pay after you approve the finished work.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during the service?
faqs.a: Someone should be present to let our team in and approve the work. For cleaning and painting we can agree a schedule that suits you.

faqs.q: Do you provide materials and spare parts?
faqs.a: Yes. We can supply genuine parts and materials at a listed price, or you can provide your own. Parts are always quoted separately and clearly.

faqs.q: Which areas of Lahore do you cover?
faqs.a: We cover most of Lahore, including DHA, Gulberg, Johar Town, Model Town, Bahria Town and Wapda Town. See the Areas page or ask us on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can I book a regular maintenance plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Annual Care Plans bundle AC servicing, plumbing and electrical checks at a discounted yearly price. See the Pricing page.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
faqs.a: Tell us and we will come back and make it right at no cost within the warranty period. Your satisfaction is how we earn repeat customers.
